review.note: Written in M41b from the cached Wikipedia leads it cites, to join an actor the second Portuguese round imported to a record the atlas already held. The interval is either the actors' own, and only as good as those records, or it was written from memory. Neither has been read in a source.

note: Founded in April 1918 around him and known as the Sidonist party; he was killed that December. Neither lead says who, if anyone, led it afterwards.
